findings.finding: Use sums: a+A=2b+2B and a+A=b+B+10 ⇒ b+B=10, a+A=20. So A=20−a, B=10−b, a≤15. Equations become a(20−a)=4b(10−b) and a(15−a)=b(15−b). Brute‑force a∈1..15, b∈1..10 → only (a,b)=(10,5). Product=50.
Use A+a=2(B+b), Aa=4Bb, after giving 5 sweets: A+a= B+b+10, A(a-5)=B(b+5). Derive B+b=10, A+a=20 → a=20‑A, b=10‑B. Then A(20‑A)=4
